item.title: Blog: Getting the Topology Right with OpenTelemetry Traces: Gateways, Queues and Databases
item.dc:creator: Kai Wan
item.description: SkyWalking draws its topology from OTLP spans alone. Gateways, message brokers and databases reached at several addresses are where that gets hard. This post runs each case on a laptop, shows the topology before and after, and the one change that fixes it.

item.title: Blog: OpenTelemetry Traces in SkyWalking: Native Storage, Metrics and Topology
item.dc:creator: Kai Wan
item.description: SkyWalking now stores OTLP traces as they arrive and turns them into service metrics, topology and database, cache and MQ dashboards through the new Trace Analysis Language. This quick start runs the OpenTelemetry Astronomy Shop against SkyWalking with one command, and shows what to set in your own applications.

item.title: Blog: Collect Cloud Sessions, Evaluate Locally: Analyzing AI Agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with Apache SkyWalking AI Sessionizer
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Deploy a real Bedrock-powered agent, collect its execution records with Apache SkyWalking AI Sessionizer, and pull them locally for evaluation. Follow the commands and HTML report screenshots to check completion, evidence, and execution efficiency.

item.description: Run a LangGraph agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime and record every turn, model prompt, tool call and file change in Apache SkyWalking AI Sessionizer while the session runs, kept after it ends, with no change to the agent's logic.
